known_limits: The analyzer is deterministic and bilingual rather than a learned open-domain language model.
Actor extraction and complement recognition remain controlled and heuristic.
Free indirect discourse, unrestricted morphology, arbitrary scope islands, and deep mixed-language nesting remain incomplete.
Pronoun attribution and long-distance source resolution are not general.
The graph records beliefs but does not yet maintain temporal belief revision, retraction, or contradiction history.
Source reliability and evidential strength are represented categorically but not calibrated.
General entailment and world-knowledge reasoning over attributed propositions are not implemented.
No broad open-domain corpus, human calibration study, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains below GPT-grade breadth, robustness, knowledge, and calibration.
next_frontier: temporally versioned belief, contradiction, retraction, and supersession state
nested modal, negation, quantifier, and counterfactual scope
attribution-aware questions and answers that never convert reported content into fact
evidential reliability and provenance composition without lexical authority
pronoun and long-distance actor resolution across turns
larger family-held-out adversarial dialogue suites with calibrated abstention
